steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each fact is matched to the document that supports it. A fact with no reference is a gap.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Fact with no document reference
findings.fix: Cite the document that supports the fact

findings.title: Date conflicts with another in the file
findings.fix: Resolve the conflict before the summary goes out

findings.title: Exposure figure with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the figure

outcome.notChecked: The merits; facts not in the file.

pros: Checks a fact with no document reference, a date that conflicts with another in the file, and an exposure figure with no source.
cons: Not checked: The merits; facts not in the file.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-legal-dispute-summary skill on the records for this review.
